map_info.name: Rotation Spectacle: tunnel and five stacks
map_info.description: An exhibition hall on the museum floor. A boolean tunnel accumulates rotation through fourteen segments; five carousel cake profiles hold one layered speed rule in different silhouettes.

learning_objectives: Follow accumulated orientation along a boolean tunnel
Compare five carousel profiles under the same layered rotation rule
Distinguish a repeated spatial angle from angular motion over time
